answer_1.quote: Image Captioning. Image captioning is one of the most popular image-text tasks ... We introduce a new benchmark, OLIVE, to evaluate open-ended model responses to diverse instructions.
answer_1.outputs: Image captions, answers to visual questions, and responses to open-ended instructions.

answer_2.quote: The performance metrics used are AUC for Hateful Memes, CIDEr for OpenCQA, OLIVE, and all captioning datasets, ROUGE-L (Lin, 2004) for MORE and New Yorker Explanation, and accuracy for the remaining tasks.
